title: Nice Looking!
text: Nice Looking!. This is a nice looking tiered tray. It does require some assembly. It is sturdy enough for decorating, but it seems like the posts may loosen over time and require tightening up. It is larger than I expected. I was going to use this for decor, but I don't have enough items to make it look good so I'm keeping my smaller tray for my monthly themed decor. This would be great for parties such as holding sweets.

product_metadata.title: Perfnique Tiered Tray Stand, Brown Wooden 2 Tier Tray with 58'' Wood Beads Garland, Serving Tray, Farmhouse Rustic Home Kitchen Table Decor, Morden Decor Set for Shelf Coffee Bar (Dark Brown)
features: [Ideal Choice for Farmhouse Decor] These adorable decorative tiered trays are nothing less than perfection. It comes with a 2 tier tray and a 58in-long wooden beads garland. They are always the best way to add a rustic accent to your home!

[More Room for Displaying] Our serving tray is designed in the shape of rectangular, with a bottom tray of 16 x 12 inches and a top tray of 11.5 x 8.5 inches. Each tray is 1 inch deep. The assembly height is 17 inches. It can be placed almost anywhere, and the 7-inch gap between the bottom and top trays gives lots of room to display taller decorative items.

[Built to Last for Many Years] Functional yet elegant, this two-tiered tray is made of beautiful fine-grained and warp-resistant Paulownia wood. Our farmhouse-style wood two-tiered tray has a sturdy metal handle on top so you can easily carry it. It will LAST A LONG TIME in your home.

[Includes Wooden Beads Garland] The wooden bead string is included in this tiered tray decor set, measuring 58 in length. Make a perfect addition to your vintage, shabby chic, and bohemian center pieces decoration for dining table.

[Easy to Assemble] Come with all accessories that you need. It can be put together and used for serving or seasonal decor in just a minute. Designed from quality wood and improved clasp to ensure the trays remain stable at all times.
[Authentic Distressed Wood] We pride ourselves on the high-quality processing unique to our brand. Recycled high-quality wood and hand distressing provide an authentic farmhouse feel and shabby chic.

[For All Occasions] With its irresistible charm and ample space, this 2 tier Lazy Susan can be decorated to entertain any holiday or special themed events such as Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas, 4th of July, valentines day, St Patrick's day, easter, birthday parties, and many more. Also, serve a variety of cake, cupcake desserts, cheeses, and fruits for your next party and let guests marvel at your show-stopping decorative tier tray.
